title: Interactive Support Mode Features
overview:
Enhance support mode with interactive commands, notifications, configuration file support, and multi-repository monitoring capabilities.

**Motivation:** Transforms support mode from a passive monitoring tool into an active, production-ready companion that enhances developer experience

**Success criteria:**
- Keyboard shortcuts work during monitoring (s, t, c, q, r)
- Desktop notifications on state changes
- Configuration file support (.support.toml or .support.yaml)
- Multi-repository monitoring with tabular output

**Technical constraints:**
- Implement graceful SIGINT/SIGTERM handling
- Support both console and JSON output formats
- Enable/disable features via configuration

**In scope:**
- Keyboard shortcuts for summary, tracker status, commits, quit, refresh
- Desktop notifications and optional webhooks
- Configuration file with YAML/TOML support
- Multi-repository monitoring
**Out of scope:**
- Mobile notifications
- Custom UI frameworks

**Signals:** priority: medium
